title: Hull surprises Man Utd with win in season opener
seoTitle: Hull surprises Man Utd with 2-0 victory
subtitle: City makes history by beating United 2-0 at the MKM Stadium
excerpt: Hull City beats Manchester United 2-0 in their Premier League opener, marking a stunning debut performance.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Hull City made history by defeating Manchester United 2-0 in the opening match of their new Premier League season at the MKM Stadium. The result surprised fans and football observers alike, heralding a triumphant start for the side that has returned to the top flight.

The match, played on the competition's first weekend, saw Hull City secure a two‑goal victory over United, sealing the win for the visitors. Hull City's performance was highlighted as a milestone in its English football journey.

The outcome was recorded as a shock, as Hull City was not considered a favourite to beat Manchester United. The game ended 2‑0 in Hull City's favour for the current Premier League season.

With information from BBC Sport.
